capabilities: Look up selected words or search from a dictionary sidebar
Save definitions into templated vocabulary notes
Create one flashcard per definition and review due cards
Install offline dictionary packs with checksum verification
Translate text and read it aloud through optional providers
extras: Translation and speech are off by default; offline packs are published separately in the Mynary Offline Dictionary dataset and are checked before Wiktionary. No telemetry, advertising, or account system.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a word while writing, or to turn definitions into notes and study material.

relations.evidence: In Anki, choose File → Import, select the exported .txt file

requires.name: MTranServer, LibreTranslate, Supertonic, or OpenAI-compatible server
Translation or TTS provider API key

summary: Dictionary lookup plugin that fetches Wiktionary definitions, saves them as templated vocabulary notes, and studies them as spaced-repetition flashcards.
